name.description: The name of the service being requested

description.description: The description of the API being called

requestDate.description: The date and time the API is being called in GMT

ecbReferenceRateDate.description: Date of reference rates issued by the European Central Bank (ECB).

ecbReferenceRate.description: Euro foreign exchange reference rates issued by the European Central Bank (ECB). When neither the transaction currency nor the cardholder billing currency is equal to Euro, a calculated reference rate is derived from the two ECB rates

transCurr.description: Currency of the transaction as provided in the API request

crdhldBillCurr.description: Cardholder billing currency as provided in the API request

rateDate.description: The date of the requested rates

transAmt.description: Amount in transaction currency as provided in the API request

bankFeePct.description: Percentage bank fee as provided in the API request

bankFeeFixed.description: Fixed bank fee as provided in the API request

effectiveConversionRate.description: Calculated effective exchange rate for the requested currency pair including all issuer-to-cardholder fees. This is calculated by dividing cardholder billing amount including all fees divided by the transaction amount (crdhldBillAmtInclAllFees / transAmount)

pctDifferenceMastercardExclAllFeesAndEcb.description: Calculated percentage difference between Mastercard Conversion Rate excluding all issuer-to-cardholder fees for the selected currency pair and the ECB Reference Rate

pctDifferenceMastercardInclAllFeesAndEcb.description: Calculated percentage difference between Mastercard Conversion Rate Including all issuer-to-cardholder fees (fixed and percentage) for the selected currency pair and the ECB Reference Rate ([effectiveConversionRate/ecbReferenceRateDate]-1*100)

mastercardFxRateDate.description: Date of Mastercard issued conversion rates. The date can differ to the requested rate date if no new rates are published for the requested date or if the user requests for a historical date

mastercardConvRateInclPctFee.description: Mastercard exchange rate for the requested currency pair including issuer-to-cardholder percentage rate fee as provided by the issuer in the API call

mastercardConvRateExclAllFees.description: Mastercard exchange rate for the requested currency pair excluding any issuer-to-cardholder fees

crdhldBillAmtInclAllFees.description: Cardholder Billing Amount as calculated by applying the Mastercard Conversion Rate, including any applicable issuer-to-cardholder fees (percentage and fixed)

crdhldBillAmtExclAllFees.description: Cardholder billing amount calculated by using the Mastercard conversion rate, excluding any applicable issuer-to-cardholder fees
